# Paths that exist only on the claude branch. Used by sync-main.sh, check-no-claude-files.sh and the dotnet new template.
# "dir/" matches that folder from the repo root, "**/dir/" a folder with that name at any depth,
# "**/NAME" a file named exactly NAME at any depth. Any other shape stops the sync with an error.
# scripts/claude-paths.sh always applies these same patterns as a floor, even if a line is removed here.
**/.claude/
docs/claude/
docs/superpowers/
.impeccable/
**/CLAUDE.md
**/CLAUDE.local.md
